name: Darshan Orna Limited
about: Darshan Orna Limited wholesales and trades gold and silver jewelry and ornaments in India. It offers traditional, Indo-western, and modern jewelry products, such as chains, rings, ear chains, earrings, bracelets, anklets, zudas, bangles, toe rings, and necklaces. Darshan Orna Limited was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
